items.content_text: Every retrieval demo you have ever seen used clean input. Markdown files, a folder of blog posts, maybe a tidy CSV. You chunk it, embed it, query it, and the answers come back right. Then somebody points it at the documents the business actually runs on. A supplier contract in PDF.
